saw_lines: Style shoppers decide on the picture first, then check fit and fabric, and they come back when a new drop lands.
So the sale is won or lost in the picture, since 20 text ads give nothing to look at.
Your 52 Google creatives include only 6 videos against 20 text ads, so cut three short videos from your 14 image ads and run them beside the text set.
